summary: #362 mounted /api/synthetic-population-live (a synthetic person's device reporting its screen) without a route group, so its machine traffic would have been counted with people's app requests; the route-group test failed in the nightly. The routes are now the machine group. #366 renamed them /api/observatory-live and mounted the report in every app, people's included, so they are now the telemetry group: background reports nobody waits on.
